verdict.rationale: Vapi has a first-party 'understanding latency' doc that gives tuning guidance: choose speed-optimized 'Ultra Fast' models for lower latency or accept higher latency for 'High Intelligence'. Its speech-configuration docs also cover controlling when the assistant starts and stops speaking. No documented end-to-end latency numbers or benchmarks appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: published end-to-end latency figures (ms per pipeline stage or total), detailed latency-tuning guidance beyond model tier selection, independent or hands-on latency measurements corroborating speed claims.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented end-to-end voice latency numbers or tuning guidance backing the platform's speed claims

citations.quote: Ultra Fast uses speed-optimized models for lower latency. High Intelligence accepts higher latency for greater capability.
control exactly when your assistant starts and stops speaking during a conversation
